targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS "Servers" FROM inventory.server_operational_overview WHERE (${site:sqlstring}='All' OR site_key=${site:sqlstring}) AND (${rack:sqlstring}='All' OR rack_key=${rack:sqlstring}) AND (${server:sqlstring}='All' OR server_key=${server:sqlstring})

SELECT coalesce(sum(vm_count),0) AS "VMs" FROM inventory.server_operational_overview WHERE (${site:sqlstring}='All' OR site_key=${site:sqlstring}) AND (${rack:sqlstring}='All' OR rack_key=${rack:sqlstring}) AND (${server:sqlstring}='All' OR server_key=${server:sqlstring})

SELECT round(avg(cpu_utilization_percent)::numeric,1) AS "CPU" FROM inventory.server_operational_overview WHERE (${site:sqlstring}='All' OR site_key=${site:sqlstring}) AND (${rack:sqlstring}='All' OR rack_key=${rack:sqlstring}) AND (${server:sqlstring}='All' OR server_key=${server:sqlstring})

SELECT round(avg(memory_utilization_percent)::numeric,1) AS "Memory" FROM inventory.server_operational_overview WHERE (${site:sqlstring}='All' OR site_key=${site:sqlstring}) AND (${rack:sqlstring}='All' OR rack_key=${rack:sqlstring}) AND (${server:sqlstring}='All' OR server_key=${server:sqlstring})

SELECT coalesce(sum(open_alerts),0) AS "Alerts" FROM inventory.server_operational_overview WHERE (${site:sqlstring}='All' OR site_key=${site:sqlstring}) AND (${rack:sqlstring}='All' OR rack_key=${rack:sqlstring}) AND (${server:sqlstring}='All' OR server_key=${server:sqlstring})

SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE monitoring_status='unmonitored') AS "Unmonitored" FROM inventory.server_operational_overview WHERE (${site:sqlstring}='All' OR site_key=${site:sqlstring}) AND (${rack:sqlstring}='All' OR rack_key=${rack:sqlstring}) AND (${server:sqlstring}='All' OR server_key=${server:sqlstring})

SELECT initcap(health_status) AS "Health",site_name AS "Data Center",site_key AS "Site Key",rack_name AS "Rack",rack_key AS "Rack Key",hostname AS "Server",server_key AS "Server Key",manufacturer AS "Vendor",model AS "Model",physical_cores AS "Cores",pg_size_pretty(ram_bytes) AS "RAM",pg_size_pretty(local_storage_bytes) AS "Storage",round(cpu_utilization_percent::numeric,1) AS "CPU %",round(memory_utilization_percent::numeric,1) AS "Memory %",round(disk_utilization_percent::numeric,1) AS "Disk %",round(temperature_celsius::numeric,1) AS "Temp °C",round(power_consumption_watts::numeric,0) AS "Power W",vm_count AS "VMs",open_alerts AS "Alerts",initcap(monitoring_status) AS "Monitoring",operating_system AS "OS",business_service AS "Service",owner AS "Owner",last_seen_at AS "Last Seen",CASE WHEN is_simulated THEN 'Simulated' ELSE 'Live' END AS "Data Type" FROM inventory.server_operational_overview WHERE (${site:sqlstring}='All' OR site_key=${site:sqlstring}) AND (${rack:sqlstring}='All' OR rack_key=${rack:sqlstring}) AND (${server:sqlstring}='All' OR server_key=${server:sqlstring}) ORDER BY CASE health_status WHEN 'critical' THEN 1 WHEN 'warning' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END,site_name,rack_name,hostname

list.label: Data Center
list.name: site
list.query: SELECT site_key AS __value,name AS __text FROM inventory.sites ORDER BY name

list.label: Rack
list.name: rack
list.query: SELECT rack_key AS __value,site_name||' / '||name AS __text FROM inventory.rack_operational_overview WHERE (${site:sqlstring}='All' OR site_key=${site:sqlstring}) ORDER BY site_name,name

list.label: Server
list.name: server
list.query: SELECT server_key AS __value,hostname AS __text FROM inventory.server_operational_overview WHERE (${site:sqlstring}='All' OR site_key=${site:sqlstring}) AND (${rack:sqlstring}='All' OR rack_key=${rack:sqlstring}) ORDER BY hostname
